title: THREE LANGUAGES, ONE PAGE
rule: the home page exists in English, Shqip and Arabic; the switch re-sets the whole page live, and Arabic mirrors the layout right to left for real (dir=rtl, logical properties), so the page proves the right-to-left skill by being one
description: Concept C3. The first screen sets one fact in three scripts: the identity line large in the current language, and the same line in the two other languages under it, each one a button that opens the page in that language. Language names sit top-centre in their own scripts (English, Shqip, العربية). Beside the lines, two public Bayyinah TV captures (the web library on its Arabic courses tab and the App Store frame for the Arabic courses); the caption says that these show the English interface, because no Arabic-interface capture exists. Below: six rows that say what was built and the languages it shipped in, each language name in its own script (Bayyinah TV English + العربية, the care platform English, Deutsch, Español, Türkçe as text only, Viva Fresh Shqip, Read to Feed 3 languages, Incentiv English + Français, FJALË Shqip). Then 'In Albanian': FJALË (his own word game) and a Viva Fresh store frame, large. Then 'His own products': Offday (light team calendar, 2x capture, 'about 200 automatic tests', code private, no link), OFFBEAT (sound studio, cropped on its whole sequencer panel) and FORM (home with the copper trefoil), both labelled 'Concept, 2026' with their GitHub links. Footer with email, GitHub, LinkedIn and the CV. The fourth language of the title is not a page language: no fact supports a fourth language the owner writes, so the care platform's four languages are named in its row only.
signature: Type: one family name, two scripts. Literata (opsz 7-72, wght 400-600, subset 75 kB) for Latin and Albanian; Amiri Regular and Bold (Arabic subsets, 41 kB each) for Arabic, joined by unicode-range and size-adjusted 122% so an Arabic word sits at the size of a Latin word on the same line. Identity line 64 px Literata 500 at opsz 64, -0.025 em; Arabic 56 px Amiri Bold, line-height 1.5, never tracked. Arabic-Indic digits for Arabic years. No mono. Colour: a manuscript palette, ultramarine ground #1A2466, vellum text #F2EADB (11.8:1), gold #E0B252 for the active language, language names and link underlines (7.2:1), muted #C3C6E0 (8.4:1). Motion: one View Transition of 320 ms on cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1); about 50 named parts move from their old box to their mirrored box, old text fades out in 200 ms, new text fades in from 140 to 320 ms, captures move as objects and never cross-fade, the root never fades, the header stays on top, and the block the reader is on keeps its height on screen. The chosen alternate line grows into the headline while the old headline shrinks into its place. Reduced motion: instant switch. The language is in the URL (?lang=sq, ?lang=ar), on html lang and dir, and in the document title.
mechanisms: live right-to-left mirror of the whole layout
one fact in three scripts as the language switch
language names in their own scripts as row data
hook: His site flips into Arabic for real: the whole page slides to the other side and reads right to left.
holdback: Lowest: actions and seniority, 7. The page proves one skill (right-to-left and multi-language interfaces) very well; depth of the platform work sits in one sub-line ('Part of two platform rewrites') and the row roles. No Arabic-interface capture of Bayyinah TV exists in public/showcase, so the screens stay the English interface and only the layout and text mirror; the caption says so. The view transition is proven headless with paused mid-frames; the in-app browser pane was hidden during this run, and a hidden document skips view transitions, so the live click there switched instantly (dir=rtl, title changed) without the motion. At 60-120 ms the header items cross over each other. The Albanian and Arabic copy needs an owner check (translationsToCheck). Own products sit low on the page (about 3,000 px down at 1440), after the language material.
translationsNote: Every Albanian and Arabic string that differs from English. Strings left the same in all three (product names, App Store, Google Play, CV (PDF) in Albanian, Email in Albanian, Frontend and Mobile in Albanian, Latin years) are not listed.

craft.cls: 0 at every width in en, sq and ar, on load and after a fast scroll to the bottom (cold profile)
craft.targets: every link and button is at least 44 x 44 px (0 smaller at every width)
craft.focus: 2 px gold ring, 3 px offset, on every link and button
craft.hover: hover only adds a tint or underline; every action has a visible control
craft.reducedMotion: switch is instant: 0 animations 16 ms after the click, dir already rtl
craft.noWebGL: no WebGL, no canvas, no sound
craft.chunk: Draft JS 7.0 kB gzip, CSS 2.9 kB gzip (fonts excluded); fonts 75 + 41 + 41 kB, preloaded
craft.fontWait: render waits at most 300 ms; late faces fall back to a sized Georgia and Geeza Pro for the whole visit
craft.images: no capture above its pixels on a 2x screen (largest scale 1.00); Offday 0.70, OFFBEAT 0.50, FORM 0.46 at 1440

checks: npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json: no error in src/drafts/four-languages (other drafts in progress have errors). npx oxlint src/drafts/four-languages: clean.
